title: Powerfleet to Attend the 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference
summary: WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J., Sept. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Powerfleet, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIOT) ("Powerfleet" or the "Company")…...
body_markdown:
WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J.


, Sept. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Powerfleet,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777710-1&h=953225561&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.powerfleet.com%2F&a=Powerfleet%2C) Inc. (Nasdaq: AIOT) ("Powerfleet" or the "Company") today announced that management is scheduled to attend the 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference on Tuesday, September 22nd, to meet with investors to discuss Powerfleet's Unity AIoT platform, financial performance and the Company's strategy to execute on its business plan to create long-term shareholder value.


**ABOUT POWERFLEET**
Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. With more than 30 years of experience, Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data, irrespective of source, and delivers actionable insights to help companies save lives, time, and money. Powerfleet's ethos transcends our data ecosystem and commitment to innovation; our people-centric approach empowers our customers to realize impactful and sustained business improvement. The Company is headquartered in New Jersey, United States, with offices around the globe. Explore more at[www.powerfleet.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777710-1&h=2742880702&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.powerfleet.com%2F&a=www.powerfleet.com) . Powerfleet has a primary listing on The Nasdaq Global Market and a secondary listing on the Main Board of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE).
